overall_reason: Six colour tokens and square corners hold the neo-brutalist look, but the hard offset shadow runs in five sizes and spacing is typed per rule on no scale (4px share 0.43, off-scale 7 to 62px).

score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY fails on five offset-shadow recipes (TOK-004) and T-SCALE-FIT on spacing and type (TOK-002, TOK-003); colour tokens pass T-HARDCODE (87% var).

findings.where: logo mark, nav button, hero mark, floating tag, dashboard card; 1440 (tiles/1440-00.png)
findings.evidence: values.1440.shadow lists five hard offsets in one colour: 3px (span.logo-mark), 4px (span.floating-tag), 5px (nav a.button), 6px (h1 mark) and 10px (div.dashboard). Shadow declarations are 64% literal.
findings.before: Five offset depths for one style of shadow
findings.after: Two offset tokens, for example 4px for controls and 8px for panels
findings.why: The offset is the signature of the style; five depths make it look improvised.

findings.where: nav, hero, buttons, dashboard tasks; 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: values.1440.spacing has 24 values with share on 4px 0.43 and best base 6. The off_scale_spacing sweep lists 7, 9, 11, 13, 18, 19, 22, 25, 30, 38, 50 and 62px; nav gap 22px, button padding 12 by 19px, hero padding-left 38px, task padding 13px. All 41 spacing declarations are literal.
findings.before: Spacing typed per rule with no base
findings.after: One spacing scale (4 or 8px base) as tokens
findings.why: With no base, every new block picks its own gap.

findings.where: kicker, nav, dashboard, feature titles, logo; 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: values.1440.font_size has 11 sizes: 10 (kicker), 11, 12, 13 (nav), 16, 19 (feature h3), 22, 27 (logo), 32, 38, 84. All 12 font-size declarations are literal; type_ladder counts 11.
findings.after: Five or six type steps on one ratio
findings.why: Steps with no shared ratio give the type hierarchy no rule.

strengths: One corner decision: no radius anywhere.
A small named palette (--ink, --paper, --yellow, --lime, --purple, --orange) with 87% of colour declarations using var().
not_investigated: T-THEME-PARITY: no second theme in the readable CSS.
Visitor mode inferred as Persuade (a landing page); no contract.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
